item.title: Op resumes in Kathua to track down terrorists; security personnel injured
item.description: STATE TIMES NEWS JAMMU: Security forces resumed a search operation on Thursday morning to track down terrorists hiding in a forest in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kathua district.
